baseline_plan.title: Book Stack Platform on Office Chair
baseline_plan.summary: Create a raised flat surface by stacking books on the office chair seat and placing the lightweight object on top.

steps.action: Stack the books neatly on the office chair seat to form a flat, stable platform.
steps.why_it_helps: Elevates the surface above the chair seat using only available books.

steps.action: Place the small lightweight object on top of the stacked books.
steps.why_it_helps: Positions the object at the desired height for display.

assumptions: Books are rigid enough to support the lightweight object without deforming.
The chair seat can bear the combined weight of the books and the object.
unresolved_risks: Books may shift or slide off the chair if not balanced, potentially causing the object to fall.
Uneven book stacking could create an unstable surface leading to wobbling.
constraint_check: Only listed inventory objects used (office_chair_01, books_01).
No adhesives, tape, fasteners, or stands used.
No damage to inventory objects claimed.
External lightweight object used as specified.
